Neo series · N2

Neo Discovery

Released June 1, 2001 · 75 cards

Neo Discovery is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Neo series, released in English on June 1, 2001. It has 75 cards. It includes 71 Pokémon, 4 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

16 illustrators worked on Neo Discovery. Most cards: CR CG gangs (12), Hironobu Yoshida (8), Kimiya Masago (6), Shin-ichi Yoshida (6), Sumiyoshi Kizuki (6), Atsuko Nishida (5), Aya Kusube (5), K. Hoshiba, CR CG gangs (4).
